title: Molinism
description: Providence through prevolitional knowledge of creaturely counterfactuals.

title: Open theism
description: A dynamic providence in which some future free acts are not settled truths.

title: Classical theism
description: A strong cluster of classical divine attributes, without settling every account of freedom.

title: Theological determinism
description: Comprehensive divine determination with no presumption of libertarian freedom.

title: Simple foreknowledge
description: Exhaustive prior knowledge without middle knowledge as the basis of providence.

title: Temporal free-will theism
description: A temporal God and libertarian creatures, while leaving future truth open.
